messages:
olga (partner-eng): Quick heads-up — noticed a pattern in partner AWS-MP hourly -> daily rollups: about 9-12% of hourly buckets never make it into daily aggregation for some partners. Probably TTL/late-windowing issue. Paging partners/finance for potential retro credits? :thinking:

jamie (partnerships): ugh. can you paste a sample query or counts?

rahul (backend): here's quick check I ran:
```
SELECT partner_id, hour, COUNT(*) as events
FROM marketplace_hourly
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY partner_id, hour
HAVING COUNT(*) = 0
LIMIT 10;
```
looks like late arrivals with ts skew >72h, our daily rollup pipeline drops >48h by design.

katy (billing): if the system drops >48h we need a policy for credits. current SLO says 24-48h window for acceptance. anything outside is manual review. finance needs estimate of affected dollars.

tim (finance): can we get an ETA on a backfill? also need a CSV of affected partners + usage delta. we'll use that to compute provisional credits.

maria (support): looping in partner reps — do not send external comms yet. let's confirm scope.

olga (partner-eng): partner with highest impact is "Acme SI" (partner_id=1532). I can contact them once we have a remediation plan. Proposed plan: 1) run backfill for 7 days, 2) if backfill recovers >=95% mark, no credits; else calc credits and propose capped credit window. Thoughts?

rahul (backend): technically we can run an ad-hoc backfill job that re-processes raw events for the window but two caveats: a) risk of duplicate ingestion unless we mark idempotency, b) can overwhelm daily aggregator. I'd enqueue backfill with rate limit.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline started: daily-aggregator-v2 backfill mode triggered by rahul — job id bgf-9123

jamie (partnerships): +1 to rate-limited backfill. also recommend we add a fallback aggregate that accepts late events up to 7d but flags them as late so billing logic can ignore or mark for manual review.

katy (billing): agree. if we implement 'late_flag' we can decide to auto-credit or not. proposal: auto-credit only if delta > $500 per partner in 7d window; otherwise manual.

tim (finance): agree with $500 threshold. also need to add a clause for partner-tiered limits (enterprise partners get different thresholds).

olga (partner-eng): I'll draft comms for Acme SI and share a proposed timeline: backfill start T+2h, expected finish ~6h, then reconciliation and credit calc T+10h.

maria (support): please tag me when final comms go out. I'll prep support KB article.

rahul (backend): kicking off small backfill for partner_id=1532 now in staging, will post logs. If successful we'll run prod job with rate-limits.

rahul (backend): staging logs excerpt:
```
backfill: partner_id=1532 window=2025-03-10..2025-03-17 processed=18,342 late=1,348 requeued=0
```
looks promising — will proceed to prod after smoke tests.

jamie (partnerships): thanks team. action items: rahul -> prod backfill with rate-limit + idempotency header; olga -> draft comms and share timeline; katy+tim -> prepare credit calc template; maria -> KB draft. check-ins in 4hrs.

olga (partner-eng): noted. pinging @acme-rep for visibility once we hit prod.

acme-bot: Acme SI acknowledged receipt. We'll standby.

katy (billing): one more: update docs for daily aggregator TTL to make it explicit (48h -> 7d fallback policy) and link to credits policy.

rahul (backend): created PR for limiter and late-flag schema change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4567

jamie (partnerships): :thumbsup: good thread. We'll reconvene post-backfill.
